bug_semantics: containerd created several daemon directories with group/world-accessible modes (CWE-279). CreateTopLevelDirectories used 0o711 for config.Root (default /var/lib/containerd) and optional config.TempDir, so an unprivileged local user could traverse into the metadata and content stores. The CRI plugin did not create its own state directory; later os.MkdirAll of children such as volatile sandbox/container roots with 0755 therefore created /run/containerd/io.containerd.grpc.v1.cri as 0755, exposing Kubernetes local-volume contents (including possible setuid binaries) and enabling host privilege escalation. plugins/sandbox/controller.go also created the shim controller dirs with 0711. /run/containerd and io.containerd.runtime.v2.task remaining 0711 are intentional for userns-remapped containers.
flaw_origin: The first write of the overly-permissive mode on the daemon data root is a0a5cc778760fe66cc54701a404e0f5c1fa8379a (Michael Crosby, 2017-07-26, 'Add user namespace support to client'), which changed server/server.go from os.MkdirAll(config.Root, 0700) to 0711 (and the bolt plugin root the same way). The immediate parent still used 0700. Userns remapping only requires others-execute on the state directory; applying 0711 to the data root is the defect. Later refactors preserved that Root 0711: CreateTopLevelDirectories extraction (40d898a820a557e92eb94d61ed29e1d24327c1a8), MkdirAllWithACL (6034c1950a0e32fb9bc7718cead7427bfcfa2425), gofumpt 0o711 (14e621cf9192f4a8135bda270c60ec2e42c88de4). TempDir 0711 was copied from that convention in 63895de45578272b1c7bca89c2b1265070f113b9 (2021). Sandbox-controller 0711 was added in a12acedfad8e61cc518f550403b4ff2a4bcd0853 (2024). CRI's 0755 parent is a side-effect of cri-containerd's first sandbox MkdirAll(..., 0755) in bf28c7fc75fe3d6522a83f1c50eec5e4ae327ac0 (2017-05-12), later merged in-tree; the 2025 fix did not change those child 0755s, it pre-created the CRI state dir as 0700.

The line the fix actually rewrote for /var/lib/containerd is CreateTopLevelDirectories' Root mkdir. git log -L plus parent-tree grep show that mode was 0700 from the server package's first write and became 0711 in a0a5cc778760fe66cc54701a404e0f5c1fa8379a; subsequent ACL/gofumpt/move commits are not BICs. That commit is a single-parent human feature change, not a squash whose members can be reconstructed. It precedes the affected 1.x/2.x range (first in v1.0.0-alpha3) and the 2025 fixes land at the patched tags (1.7.29, 2.0.7, 2.1.5, 2.2.0) and not in the last affected tags. CRI 0755 and later 0711 copies are additional sites of the same overly-broad-dir class closed by the same patch; they are not the first write of the Root 0711 lines.
